sermon.title: New Year’s Share Day — January 2, 2022
sermon.speaker: Various (share service)
sermon.summary: A New Year’s sharing service: a song, testimonies from members in person and online, scripture on restoring the breach and the light of life, encouragement to keep knocking, and prayer for the church and nation.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Sharing begins at 21:49 after worship.

chunks.short_answer: Reconnecting with the church family he has known since 1974, and returning to serve God after years away.
chunks.text:
It’s good to see y’all. Well uh it’s great to be reconnected with the family that uh that I’ve known since 1974. It’s it’s uh crazy um. I’ve been sitting here of course I was starting to take Christmas down to my house and I tony needy uh. Were telling me about this so I was like yeah this would be awesome but uh you know I go down this journey of of you know where my where my relationship with God started and you know it started. 1974 on on first street and first in euclid um. I uh I was raised a catholic and I know I think I’d recognize a few bodies out there but most of you all know uh know me from a young man and I uh I served God I had a battle.

As some of you know that I I dealt with to serve the Lord um. But I fought that battle and and uh. Uh he was always faithful to me and he was always there with me through the through the toughest times of my life as a teenager uh um. You know trying to trying to serve God my parents were. Were not very uh to put it kindly I guess they were not very fond of me uh leaving the catholic church and going to the vine and but you know God always stood there with me and I and I fought the fight and and uh I always came through and but I as I grew up and left left la habra and joined the military and traveled around the world and served my country and got married had kids and straight.

Away a little bit came back straight away but you know God was always always jerking my neck back and he’s always been faithful and he’s always been there for me and I I always knew when when things got tough it was because I wasn’t serving him uh I’ve had an absence for a few years and I. I woke up one day and I just knew that my life. My life would never be right if I wasn’t serving God. And things would never be good and things would never be easy. Of course when we’re serving God it’s things can be tough. But when you’re not serving him they can definitely be so tough those days I just didn’t want to wake up.

chunks.section_question: What if God hasn’t freed you yet?
chunks.short_answer: Don’t give up—keep knocking and humble yourself; He promises rivers on barren heights.
chunks.text:
And he called us. He he has the gift to break the chains that bind us there are things in this life that keep us down that keep us from. Overcoming that keep us from uh. Being free. And um it becomes a weighty thing it becomes weighty to try to live in this life without Jesus. But it says seek me Jesus he says and you will find me knock and the door will be opened unto you see people think God is out to get them or God doesn’t care or is or is locking them out but Jesus said when you come.

I will answer you but don’t give up you know sometimes we are so stubborn we try one we make one inch towards God and he doesn’t do anything miraculous and we’re like oh didn’t work never mind forget it no God says knock keep knocking and part of that is humbling yourself. It’s humbling to admit hey I tried it I tried doing this and I’m wrong that’s humbling that’s hard. Especially in the beginning. And you may think that you’ve had a difficult pass you may think that you’re damaged your bruise your faulted. And you can’t um you don’t like you don’t deserve Jesus in your life and that is a lie that is a lie.

This is a promise I will make rivers flow on barren heights barren means there’s nothing being produced there’s no fruit. But. And we can feel like that we can feel like nothing’s happening nothing’s changing I’ve been going to this church forever and I don’t feel changed God says. He will make rivers flow when you come to him and springs within the valleys. I will turn the desert the dry ground into pools of water and the dry ground into springs of water water.

And you can have new living water in him. Thank you Jesus you are so good thank you Lord. faqs.answer: Come Thou Fount of Every Blessing.

faqs.question: How did Mrs. Gomez share Jesus at work?
faqs.answer: With the kids she cared for over the holidays.

faqs.question: What are Blake and Christina planning?
faqs.answer: Floor plans for a church and school.

faqs.answer: Mini videos reaching people with the gospel.
